items.title: Neuro-Symbolic Verification on Instruction Following of LLMs
items.title_zh: 面向 LLM 指令遵循的神经符号验证
items.summary: NSVIF is a general-purpose neuro-symbolic verifier that models user instructions as logical and semantic constraints and checks whether an LLM's output satisfies them, using a unified solver for constraint satisfaction. The authors release VIFBENCH and report that NSVIF significantly outperforms LLM-based verifiers, provides interpretable feedback, and improves instruction following without post-training.

items.title: Think Locally, Explain Globally: Graph-Guided LLM Investigations via Local Reasoning and Belief Propagation
items.title_zh: 局部思考、全局解释：基于图引导的 LLM 调查与信念传播
items.summary: EoG formulates open-ended investigation as abductive reasoning over a dependency graph, with an LLM performing bounded local evidence mining and cause-versus-symptom labeling while a deterministic controller manages traversal, state and belief propagation. On a representative ITBench diagnostics task it improves both accuracy and run-to-run consistency over ReAct baselines.

items.title: EFT-CoT: A Multi-Agent Chain-of-Thought Framework for Emotion-Focused Therapy
items.title_zh: EFT-CoT：面向情绪聚焦疗法的多智能体思维链框架
items.summary: EFT-CoT is a multi-agent chain-of-thought framework grounded in Emotion-Focused Therapy that runs a three-stage workflow of embodied perception, cognitive exploration and narrative intervention with eight specialized agents. The authors build EFT-Instruct from about 67,000 real help-seeking texts and fine-tune EFT-LLM, which they report outperforms strong baselines and human responses in empathic depth and structural professionalism.

items.title: LLM-Based SQL Generation: Prompting, Self-Refinement, and Adaptive Weighted Majority Voting
items.title_zh: 基于 LLM 的 SQL 生成：提示、自我改进与自适应加权多数投票
items.summary: The paper proposes SSEV, a single-agent self-refinement pipeline with weighted majority voting built on PET-SQL, reporting 85.5% execution accuracy on Spider 1.0-Dev, 86.4% on Spider 1.0-Test and 66.3% on BIRD-Dev. It then introduces ReCAPAgent-SQL, a multi-agent framework for planning, retrieval, critique, action and refinement that reaches 31% execution accuracy on the first 100 queries of Spider 2.0-Lite.

items.title: HyperGraphPro: Progress-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Structure-Guided Hypergraph RAG
items.title_zh: HyperGraphPro：面向结构引导超图 RAG 的进度感知强化学习
items.summary: HyperGraphPro is a hypergraph RAG framework that makes evidence-path progress the shared objective for retrieval and policy optimization, reranking hyperedges by query-conditioned structural distinctiveness. It adds stepwise progress-aware rewards based on coverage of answer-guided target hyperedges, and reports consistent multi-hop QA accuracy gains over existing GraphRAG methods.

items.title: Evaluating Semantic and Syntactic Understanding in Large Language Models for Payroll Systems
items.title_zh: 评估大语言模型在薪资系统中的语义与句法理解
items.summary: The study uses a synthetic payroll system as a high-stakes test of whether LLMs can understand a schema, apply rules in the right order and produce cent-accurate results, across GPT, Claude, Perplexity, Grok and Gemini model families. It identifies regimes where careful prompting is sufficient and regimes where explicit computation is required.

items.title: Spelling Bee Embeddings for Language Modeling
items.title_zh: 面向语言建模的拼写嵌入
items.summary: The authors modify the token embedding layer to infuse embeddings with spelling information, and scaling studies from 40M to 800M parameters suggest the gains are equivalent to needing about 8% less compute and data for the same test loss.

items.title: qufei1993/skills-hub
items.title_zh: skills-hub：统一管理与同步 Agent Skills 的跨平台桌面应用
items.summary: skills-hub is a cross-platform desktop app written in Rust that manages Agent Skills in one place and syncs them to the global skills directories of multiple AI coding tools.
